en: Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a group of soldiers in uniform standing guard at the entrance steps of a barracks building. Several soldiers with rifles and sabres pose on and beside the stairs under an ornate gas lamp, with a striped guardhouse in the foreground and long barracks blocks in the background. German text in red is printed at the upper left, and the publisher's credit is printed vertically at the left margin.
